_readme: Hand-maintained manifest of third-party data compiled into the Locus binary. See tools/notices/notices.py. groups: one per licence/source unit; files are globs relative to the crate root ($OUT_DIR/ = build-script output; local = path in this repo). kind: data | code (the crate's own non-Rust source). verified: true, or a note saying what could not be verified. needs_owner_decision: licence outside CLAUDE.md rule 7, reported by check as a warning (fails with --strict). ignored: third-party files the scan finds that are not compiled in; each needs unless_feature (check fails if that feature is on) or test_only (the source file whose #[cfg(test)]/#[test] code includes it; check verifies it), and must still match something the scan finds. first_party: our own embedded files (licence LicenseRef-Locus-Proprietary), not listed in the notices. licences: where each licence text comes from. forbidden: data that must never be in the build (files present in the crate's source, embedded by the scan, or behind an enabled feature); check fails if any appears.
